title: grammica leptantha
intro: Grammica leptantha, commonly known as the Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern regions of North America. This plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Grammica leptantha include relieving digestive issues, reducing fever, and soothing respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
